description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::_use_cudnn_rnn_flatten_weight() -> bool. Original Gems pytest calls and results define the full contract; do not narrow tests to this signature. The representative overload is not exclusive and does not express per-overload behavior or argument-rejection semantics; any overload-dependent behavior and all error contracts remain owned by the original Gems pytest, which must not be removed or adapted to fit this one signature. Registered ATen schema strings supplied verbatim: "aten::_use_cudnn_rnn_flatten_weight() -> bool". The single registered overload takes no parameters, so no overload/keyword/default disambiguation is needed in this artifact.
